svg.aria-label: Paramecium, a slipper-shaped single cell lying on its side with its rounded front end to the left, covered all over with short cilia and filled with granular cytoplasm. An oral groove with a fringe of cilia runs in from the lower side to the gullet near the middle. Inside are a small round food vacuole labelled I, a large kidney-shaped macronucleus labelled II, a small micronucleus lying in its notch labelled III, and two star-shaped contractile vacuoles with radiating canals, one near each end; the one at the right is labelled IV
